Task 7 bundles three distinct logical units into one task: (1) ProfileController/ProfileService with 5 endpoints, (2) SuperAdminSeeder (ApplicationRunner), and (3) HardDeleteJob (JobRunr recurring job). These are in separate packages (profile/, admin/, jobs/) addressing unrelated concerns. Each unit produces an independently testable result. The tech-spec groups them for 'thematic' reasons but they are not logically cohesive — removing SuperAdminSeeder steps would leave ProfileController fully functional and vice versa. Split candidate.
findings.fix: Consider splitting into: Task 7a (ProfileController + ProfileService), Task 7b (SuperAdminSeeder + HardDeleteJob). Both can remain in wave 4. If splitting is impractical due to task count, document the bundling rationale explicitly. As-is, the task exceeds the 3-file atomicity guideline (7 new files across 3 packages).
